title: Veromanitra Noëlle RAMIZASON
text:
I am a postdoctoral researcher in the BETSAKA project (Biodiversity-economic tradeoff and synergy assessments for conservation areas), conducted jointly by the Malagasy National Research Center in Development Economics (CERED) at the University of Antananarivo and the French National Research Institute for Sustainable Development (IRD). I am also a part-time lecturer in the Department of Economics at the Faculty of Economics, Management and Sociology (EGS) of the University of Antananarivo, and a member of the Doctoral Research Team (EAD) at the “Ecole Doctorale Écosystèmes Naturels (EDEN)” of the University of Mahajanga.
Specializing in climate change and environmental issues, I completed my PhD at the Ecole Doctorale Ecosystèmes Naturels under the supervision of Senior Professor Hery Lisy Tiana RANARIJAONA and Senior Professor Heriniaina RAMANANKIERANA.
Having a background in Applied Mathematics and Statistics with a specialization in Mathematical modeling and Actuarial science during my university studies at Aix-Marseille University in France, I gained solid professional experience in statistics, database management and national accounting before moving into research.
You can contact me at my email adress.
